what_happened: guard-destructive-git.sh refused a research fixture script whose text contained a HEAD-moving reset aimed at a scratch repository under the session scratchpad; the hook judges the command text and its own process directory, not the tree the command targets. Fixtures were rewritten to avoid reset, checkout-discard and add-all forms entirely.

Running the proposed landing predicate against 14 completed tasks in live history before recommending it exposed three facts the task description did not carry: task numbers are reused across history (438 numbers have more than one completion commit), 108 of 700 recent commits are attributable to no task, and 24 of 77 recent completions went through the post-deploy reconcile path that bypasses the cycle-postflight landing check.

Plan-time re-validation found two report premises off: (1) the completion-write caller list was incomplete (a second grep pattern found orchestrator-postflight.sh:339, command-gate-out.sh:305 and skill-base.sh:1124), and (2) the claim that per-cycle commit exits 2-6 proceed to completed is partly stale, since orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh lines 2254-2261 already demote exits 2-5 to partial. Neither changes the design; the first confirms placing the gate in update-task-status.sh.

verify-touched.sh runs the deployed tree's run-all.sh, which cannot see a suite created in the source store and not yet redeployed: it aborted with 'unknown suite basename test-task-landing-verify.sh'. Worked around by running the same resolved --only list through the source-store run-all.sh (45 passed, 1 expected failure, 1 pre-existing unrelated failure). That 47-suite run takes about 15 minutes and exceeds one Bash call; it was run detached with a PID-liveness waiter.

run-all.sh skips test-orchestrate-close-status-bind.sh (or a sibling of that name prefix) as 'not executable (exec-bit regression?)' in the source store. Predates this dispatch; not touched.

First live run of the deployed predicate (read-only --check). Task 673 itself: LANDING-VERIFIED, 11 commits, 15 paths. Task 669 (already completed, no proof recorded because it completed before the gate existed): V4 refused, naming four paths that task 673, which depends on it, edited afterwards. This is the dependent-task shape the idempotence short-circuit exists for; with no proof on record there is nothing to short-circuit on. It has no effect on 669, whose status write is a no-op, and it means a completed task without a proof cannot be re-verified once a dependent has landed.
